resources.string: One key per line, in toolbar order. Examples: Ctrl+Shift+X, Alt+Enter, F5. Supports Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Meta with A–Z, 0–9, F1–F12, Tab, Esc, Enter, Space, arrows, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Insert, Delete and Backspace. Remove a line to delete it. Your terminal application determines how a combination behaves.
Check the key combination on line %1$d.
Each combination can appear only once.
You can define up to %1$d custom keys.
